server.os-port-probe-timeout-ms:
1000 3000
Java edition binds port 20000. OS-level listener (if present) also occupies port 20000. When OS port is probed alive, the Java server may relay queries to it. Communication is opportunistic — they sometimes talk, sometimes they don't.

djl.description: Uses DJL for local inference. If DJL jars are not on classpath, falls back to keyword heuristics. Download DJL jars via the download script: scripts/bash/strernary/download-djl.sh
